segments.text: Greetings and welcome to this massive open online course introduction to
bioresk management. I am your instructor Kenneth and I will be guiding you over
this five week course which has been especially designed and developed for
biosafety officers, bioresk managers, facility managers, researchers and
laboratory technicians involved in the management of biological agents.
Biological agents such as bacteria and viruses pose an increasing threat to
public health and safety and management of the risks associated with these
biological agents is paramount to developing diagnostic procedures as well
as therapeutic agents. This five-week course will focus on risk assessment, risk
mitigation and performance assessment. You will learn how to apply risk
assessment to identify specific risks associated with biological agents. You
will learn how to apply the five controls to mitigate the risks posed by
biological agents and you will learn to assess the performance of your control
measures. I look forward to your participation in this five-week course
and wish you a pleasant learning experience. Thank you for watching this
